command: set -eu; export PGPASSWORD="$POSTGRES_PASSWORD"; export PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=10; exec psql -X -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1

final_verification.sql: SELECT json_build_object('epheros_absent',NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='epheros'),'original_data_directory_absent',NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_ls_dir('base') AS entry WHERE entry='406059'),'databases',(SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(x)) FROM (SELECT oid,datname,pg_get_userbyid(datdba) AS owner,datallowconn AS allow_connections FROM pg_database ORDER BY datname) x));
